paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. KV cache budget=1/64.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relative change in the LB-Avg of 2×tokens for Layer-12, Layer-13-20, Layer-21-28, and Layer-29-32, compared to the Baseline of 4× tokens. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and displays a linear scale ranging from Layer-1-4 to Layer-29-32, with tick intervals of one layer. The y-axis is a logarithmic scale ranging from -25% to 5%, with tick intervals of 5%. The first line, colored orange and represented by a circle marker and a solid line, shows a value of approximately -10% at Layer-1-4 and fluctuates around -6% across the subsequent layers. The second line, colored red and represented by a circle marker and a solid line, remains consistently around -2% from Layer-1-4 until Layer-13-20, then decreases to approximately -8% at Layer-21-28 and -10% at Layer-29-32. A third line, colored teal and represented by a circle marker and a dashed line, begins at approximately -18% at Layer-1-4, and steadily decrements to approximately -28% at Layer-21-28. The fourth line, colored blue and represented by a circle marker and a dashed line, remains at approximately -6% from Layer-1-4 until Layer-13-20, then decreases to approximately -14% at Layer-21-28 and -16% at Layer-29-32.
